result: If I had the power to change the world in one way, I would eradicate all forms of extreme poverty, ensuring that every person on the planet has access to basic necessities such as clean water, nutritious food, adequate housing, and healthcare. I believe that eliminating poverty would not only improve the quality of life for billions of people but also foster a more equitable and just world, breaking the cycle of suffering and lack that plagues so many. In turn, a globally prosperous and healthy population would enable us to address other major challenges, such as climate change, education, and social inequality, paving the way for a sustainable and compassionate world for future generations.
